academicReview.targetComparability: Arts, cultural objects, interpretation and their historical/social/theoretical contexts define this target. The closest option has substantial actual art-history, literary and film/media content, rather than coherence alone. The second option is strengthened by three replacements giving cultural objects greater weight. The third emphasises interpretation, adaptation and a four-course communication sequence; its5-course difference from the closest includes both direct and specific complementary study. These are qualified related-field responses to the coherent official indicative2027cohort. Specialist music/performance/festival and separate-thesis gaps remain material and visible.

selection.assessment: Three provisional concepts remain supported by exact-target interests and actual UCR content: broad arts/media/cultural analysis; culture, identity and power; literature, film and communication. Three institutional-politics courses in the second route are replaced with art history, stylistics and film adaptation to give cultural objects adequate weight. Performance/music/festival interests remain evidenced but cannot produce an additional included route under the three-alternative maximum, and UCR lacks the dedicated music and performing-arts sequence. These concepts respond to the defining arts-and-cultural-interpretation substance of the official indicative 2027 intake pathway; specialist music, performance, festival and thesis gaps remain explicit.
